name: CasiVision
summary:
CasiVision develops machine-vision and intelligent-inspection technology for industrial production. Its portfolio combines optical imaging, automated analysis and electromechanical equipment, organized around the ideas of a 'smart eye,' 'smart brain' and 'smart hand.' The company supplies both enabling technology and integrated inspection systems.

Application areas described on its site include semiconductors, new-energy manufacturing, furniture panels and textiles. Its work spans how an image is acquired, how defects or features are recognized, and how a machine acts on the result. This places CasiVision within the industrial perception and automation ecosystem that supports intelligent machines, rather than defining its business solely around humanoid robots.
